data.title: Bitcoin Rally Pushes Investor Sentiment to Near Two-Year High, CryptoQuant Analyst Says
data.description:
CryptoQuant analyst Darkfost said Bitcoin's latest rally has lifted investor sentiment to its most optimistic level in nearly two years, with a related market sentiment gauge briefly rising above 89 and entering the extreme greed zone. According to ChainCatcher, the last similar reading was seen in March 2024.

Darkfost said overly optimistic or pessimistic sentiment often warrants attention for possible trend reversals. The indicator has since eased from its earlier euphoric level and is moving back toward a more normal range, while Bitcoin is trying to hold its current level.

data.title: IG Holds 52% Chance to Beat AL in LPL Playoff Prediction Market
data.description:
The predict.fun market for the LPL playoff matchup between IG and AL shows IG with a 52% chance of winning. According to Odaily, the LPL playoff losers' bracket final between IG and AL is scheduled for 5 p.m. today in a best-of-five series.

The winner will advance to tomorrow's LPL final against BLG for the championship, while the loser will be eliminated from the playoffs. Both teams have already secured spots in the winners' bracket of the World Championship qualification stage, so either side can still reach Worlds through the qualifiers if it loses this match.

IG reached the playoffs through the Knights' Road and then defeated TES 3-2, WE 3-1, and LGD 3-0. AL beat LGD 3-1 in the first playoff round before losing 0-3 to BLG in the winners' bracket final.

data.title: Lil Durk Acquitted In Federal Murder-For-Hire Case
data.description: According to the BBC, Grammy-winning rapper Lil Durk was acquitted on Friday of all charges in a federal murder-for-hire case that accused him of orchestrating a revenge killing in Los Angeles four years ago. The Chicago artist, whose legal name is Durk Devontay Banks, was arrested in 2024 and had faced five felony counts, including murder for hire resulting in death and conspiracy; he remains in custody ahead of a separate trial on 5 October on racketeering murder and firearms charges. Defense lawyer Drew Findling said Banks was thankful after the verdict, while First Assistant US Attorney Bill Essayli said prosecutors look forward to presenting evidence at the second trial. Two co-defendants, Deandre "OTF Dede" Wilson and David "Browneyez" Lindsey, were convicted of stalking and conspiracy to commit stalking but were acquitted of murder-for-hire charges. The case stemmed from an August 2022 shooting at a Los Angeles petrol station that killed Saviay'a Robinson, the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo, whose real name is Tyquian Bowman.

data.title: Firefighters Test Glutathione After Los Angeles Wildfire Exposure
data.description:
According to the BBC, Pasadena Fire Captain David Marquez said he felt better after inhaling glutathione following the Eaton Fire in Los Angeles, which killed 19 people and destroyed 9,000 buildings. The wildfire was the second most destructive in California history.

The International Association of Fire Fighters issued a rare warning about glutathione last month, citing two recent recalls tied to contaminants at compounding pharmacies and saying there is no large-scale research proving the treatment is safe or effective. Sean DeCrane, the union's assistant to the general president for health and safety, said the group does not know whether glutathione works, whether any benefit is a placebo effect, or what its long-term effects may be.

The Integrated Health Action Network, formerly the Integrative Healers Network, has sent volunteer clinicians to major wildfires across the US to provide glutathione and other naturopathic treatments. Co-founder Jen Riegle said the group's data are anecdotal and not clinical trial evidence, but she wants researchers to study the treatment further. California's state Board of Pharmacy had proposed rules last year that would have sharply restricted glutathione production, but later abandoned the plan after opposition from firefighters.

data.title: Gen Z Learns 9/11 Through Family Stories, School Lessons
data.description:
According to the BBC, a new generation of Americans who were not alive or were too young to remember the 11 September 2001 attacks is learning about 9/11 through family memories, school lessons and their own research. The article says 25 states require or expect public schools to teach the attacks, while 13 make instruction optional, according to a recent Associated Press analysis, and some states do not specify a curriculum.

Several Gen Z interviewees told the BBC they first heard about the attacks in elementary school or from relatives, then later sought out more detail on their own. Avery Black, 20, said she learned about 9/11 in school and later heard her mother describe where she was when it happened; Annie Erickson, 26, said her first memories came from her mother’s personal account of a friend who died in the towers. Allegra Tashjian, 28, said she was surprised to learn about the attacks in early grade school and later asked her mother whether she remembered planes crashing in New York.

The article also quotes academics saying interest in 9/11 remains strong among younger students. David Schanzer of Duke University said his course on 9/11 and its aftermath is full, with dozens on a waitlist, while Thomas Schwartz of Vanderbilt University said some students tend to joke about the attacks, though those with family memories of the day are often more cautious.

data.title: Iran, Iraq and Gulf States to Hold Regional Meeting in Oman on September 14
data.description: Iran, Iraq and other Gulf coastal states will hold a regional meeting in Oman on September 14, according to Jiemian News. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said the talks will cover regional issues and the results of negotiations between Iran and Oman on the security of maritime passage through the Strait of Hormuz. Baghaei said Iran seeks to ensure shipping safety in the strait, but added that safety cannot be guaranteed as long as what he described as U.S. maritime blockade, economic warfare and illegal interference continue.

data.title: STOCKS | Ford Recalls 223,472 Vehicles in the U.S. Over Fuel Tank Issue
data.description: U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said Ford Motor is recalling 223,472 vehicles in the United States because fuel tanks may leak and be improperly secured, allowing them to detach while driving. According to Sina Finance, the recall covers some 2023 to 2027 Ford F-150 models, and dealers will inspect and replace the tank retaining straps free of charge if needed.

data.title: China Overseas Wins Shenzhen Core District Residential Plot for 2.55 Billion Yuan
data.description:
China Overseas Land & Investment won a 5,844.41-square-meter residential plot in Shenzhen's Futian district for 2.55 billion yuan on September 10, after 250 rounds of offline bidding, according to Jiemian News. The deal implies a floor price of 98,069 yuan per square meter and a premium of 125.46%; excluding supporting construction, the effective residential floor price is about 103,147 yuan per square meter.

The B401-0151 site, at the northwest corner of the intersection of Antuoshan Fourth Road and Qiaoxiang Third Road in the Xiangmihu area, has planned gross floor area of 26,002 square meters, a plot ratio of about 3.1 and a height limit of 100 meters. It was offered with a starting price of 1.131 billion yuan and no ceiling on the land price. The plot was originally commercial land and was later rezoned for residential use. Under the plan, it includes 24,722 square meters of housing, 1,000 square meters of transferable commercial space, 100 square meters for property services and 180 square meters for a telecom equipment room. The project requires delivery with title registration upon handover, construction to start within one year and completion within four years.

Seven developers, including China Overseas, China Resources Land, China Merchants Shekou, C&D, a Yuexiu-Deep Industry consortium, China Railway and Shenzhen Zhenye, took part in the bidding. The site is the first core-area residential land sold in Shenzhen after the city's August 28 housing policy easing, and the first pure commodity housing plot in Xiangmihu since 2017. Jiemian News reported that the strong bidding reflected demand for scarce core land in the Xiangmihu-Antuoshan area, which has limited new housing supply and no mandatory affordable-housing or talent-housing allocation.

The article also said China Overseas reported contracted property sales of 134.35 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, up 11.8% year on year, while new land purchases totaled 9 plots with attributable land cost of about 7.66 billion yuan. By the end of June, its land bank excluding China Overseas Grand Oceans had a total gross floor area of 22.07 million square meters, with attributable gross floor area of 19.6 million square meters, and about 86.5% in first-tier and strong second-tier cities. In August, Chairman Yan Jianguo said the company kept its full-year target for attributable new land investment at 80 billion to 100 billion yuan.

data.title: India's SEBI Seeks Public Input on Closing Auction, Derivatives Settlement Changes
data.description: India's Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on September 12 issued a consultation paper seeking public comments on changes to the closing auction session (CAS), derivatives contract settlement methods and market trading hours, according to Jiemian News. SEBI said it is studying two ways to calculate derivatives expiry settlement prices and may adopt a hybrid VWAP method that combines continuous trading and closing auction trades. It also proposed two trading-hour options: under Option A, continuous trading for CAS stocks would run until 3:30 pm, followed by the closing auction, while derivatives trading would be extended to 3:45 pm; under Option B, continuous trading for CAS stocks would end at 3:15 pm, CAS would run from 3:15 pm to 3:25 pm, and derivatives trading would end at 3:30 pm. SEBI also proposed banning limit orders that deviate by more than 1% from the reference price from being canceled during the closing auction, while still allowing price improvements and the remaining quantity of unfilled iceberg orders to enter CAS. The regulator said the proposal follows market feedback after CAS was implemented on August 3, 2026, and aims to improve the link between cash and derivatives markets and the closing price discovery mechanism. Public comments are due by October 3.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Xi to Take Spotlight at Modi’s BRICS Summit as Iran War Deepens
data.description:

The gathering comes as the conflict threatens to widen divisions among the bloc’s members.
